You are a careful note-taker. Read the meeting transcript below and produce a structured summary with exactly these four sections, in this order, using these exact Markdown headings:

## Decisions
- One bullet per concrete decision the participants made. If none, write a single bullet: "- None recorded."

## Action Items
- One bullet per task. Format each as: "WHO: WHAT (by WHEN if a date or deadline is mentioned)". If the owner is unclear, prefix with "Unassigned:". If no action items, write a single bullet: "- None recorded."

## Open Questions
- One bullet per unresolved question or topic flagged for follow-up. If none, write a single bullet: "- None recorded."

## Brief Recap
A 3-5 sentence narrative summary of what the meeting was about and how it progressed.

Rules:
- Only output the summary in the format above. No preamble. No closing remarks. No "Here is the summary:".
- Do not invent facts. If something is ambiguous, prefer to omit rather than guess.
- Quote sparingly; paraphrase by default.

---
TRANSCRIPT:
Alice: We will ship Friday.
Bob: Confirmed.
